title: insilicoPCR
description: Portable desktop and command-line application for in silico PCR against genome assemblies (FASTA) and sequencing reads (FASTQ), with realistic amplicon calling (each primer and probe site judged by its melting temperature on the template, with Primer3's thermodynamic alignment, a weighted 3'-end mismatch check, primer orientation and product size limits), a report of why each assay gave no product, qPCR probe support, multiplex reactions and circular sequences, read-level calling and read extension for FASTQ input, a check of every input file before the run, consolidated TSV and HTML reports, and a synthetic gel visualizer.
